item.title: Managing Global Address List (GAL) Visibility with PowerShell
item.description: A comprehensive guide to managing user visibility in the Global Address List (GAL) using PowerShell, covering both on-premises Active Directory and Exchange Online environments with detailed scripts for checking and modifying the msExchHideFromAddressLists attribute.
